title: The role of municipal wastewater in the spread of genetic determinants of microbial resistance to antibiotics into the environment
description: The specific objective of the project is to analyze the resistome in municipal wastewater and in the river at different distances from the city upstream and downstream to assess the role of the anthropogenic factor in the spread of resistance and the rivers ability to self-cleaning due to the natural elimination of microbiota of anthropogenic origin.
center: Institute of Bioengineering, Research Center of Biotechnology of RAS
samples: MIGS Cultured Bacterial/Archaeal sample from Citrobacter portucalensis
